ranges.definition: core/chart-history.js days (1Y 366, 3Y 1096, 5Y 1827 calendar days back from the last observation; MAX = whole display window)
ranges.shown: core/europe-discover-eligibility.js chart(..., range).ready AND core/chart-history.js available() (>= 95 % span, >= 5 points)
ranges.continuousValid: shown AND 0 missing rule-calendar sessions AND 0 severe/identity breaks in the window (visualQualityStatus CLEAN, scripts/discover/europe-chart-continuity.mjs)
ranges.chartReadyWindow: shown AND no gap > 5 sessions AND no break AND no stale tail AND missing ratio <= 2 % (CHART_READY rule)

rules.calendar: audited exact-MIC calendar (europe_449_calendar_audit.json, exchange_calendars 4.13.2) inside 2010-01-04..2026-10-30, core/europe-exchange-calendar.js vu-europe-exchange-calendar-1 after it
rules.visibleGap: maximal run of consecutive missing rule-calendar sessions between two displayed observations; the stale tail after the last observation is counted separately
